shortcut_pattern_cn: 强光学线程加SAR亮点等于同一车辆
why_it_is_invalid_cn: a bright point is only scattering_atom unless scale composition drift and contrast are checked
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: same vehicle identity from one optical cue and one SAR atom
correct_treatment_cn: treat as at most candidate mechanism evidence and require shell/negative contrast

shortcut_pattern_cn: SAR GT重叠加弱光学线程升级身份
why_it_is_invalid_cn: posthoc overlap cannot upgrade weak optical identity or boundary status

shortcut_pattern_cn: 方位接近加亮散射等于最终支持
why_it_is_invalid_cn: geometry feasible domain is not a selected SAR box and bright scatter may be background
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: final support or selected candidate from proximity
correct_treatment_cn: require vehicle-scale morphology temporal compatibility and non-target rejection

shortcut_pattern_cn: 多个弱线索相加成强真值
why_it_is_invalid_cn: heuristic stacking hides missing physical association and counterexamples
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: strong truth from summed weak cues
correct_treatment_cn: require joint-factor gates rather than weighted accumulation

shortcut_pattern_cn: posthoc SAR GT证据写回runtime先验
why_it_is_invalid_cn: GT can validate or falsify but cannot construct runtime factor values
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: runtime prior has been validated because it was built from GT
correct_treatment_cn: separate runtime construction layer from GT posthoc validation layer

why_it_is_invalid_cn: threshold derived from GT crop leaks posthoc evidence into algorithm construction
correct_treatment_cn: keep morphology reading posthoc until independent calibration exists

shortcut_pattern_cn: GT中心定义方位/距离因子
why_it_is_invalid_cn: using GT center as sector or range source turns validation anchor into construction input
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: runtime geometry factor is correct because it points to GT
correct_treatment_cn: define sector from runtime-safe geometry only then audit with GT

shortcut_pattern_cn: GT重叠无负例对照即机制证明
why_it_is_invalid_cn: positive-only validation does not reject road edge background guardrail or competitor alternatives
correct_treatment_cn: require negative non-target contrast before promotion
notes: positive GT-local fit alone is insufficient

shortcut_pattern_cn: 小组件盒解释为车辆外壳
why_it_is_invalid_cn: tiny component or top-k peak is atom/part not vehicle-scale shell
correct_treatment_cn: use atom/part/shell hierarchy and reject without vehicle scale

shortcut_pattern_cn: 边界因子因一个SAR cue而放松
why_it_is_invalid_cn: preserved boundary and competitor risk cannot be overridden by one posthoc cue
what_it_would_wrongly_claim: different vehicles may be merged safely
correct_treatment_cn: keep boundary blocked until independent boundary evidence closes it

why_it_is_invalid_cn: ridge alone may be road edge guardrail or static reflector
correct_treatment_cn: require endpoint weak-side shell temporal drift and negative contrast

shortcut_pattern_cn: 机制支持转成标注许可
why_it_is_invalid_cn: mechanism explanation is not annotation permission or SAR-ready output
correct_treatment_cn: keep relation outcome explanatory until later protocol explicitly opens annotation
